ld.description: Mild by Nature® Argan Oil Hand Cream Marula Oil and Shea Butter with Superfruits Açai, Goji, Pomegranate, and Seabuckthorn Premium Oils from Avocado, Coconut, Jojoba, Sesame, and Olive pH Balanced and Cruelty-Free For Soft, Smooth, Healthier-Looking Skin Formulated Without Parabens, Phthalates, or Dyes No Fragrance Added Made in the USA with Globally Sourced Materials Show your hands some love with the Mild by Nature® Argan Oil Hand Cream. This concentrated, moisture-rich, and fragrance-free hand cream helps to rehydrate dry skin. Formulated with argan nut and marula oils, shea butter, plus a premium blend of select oils that are rich in essential fatty acids, our Hand Cream will moisturize your skin – making it feel silky smooth. A proprietary blend of superfruits, including açai, goji, pomegranate, and sea buckthorn, has also been added to nourish and soften your skin.
